title: EdTech Content & Product Manager
description:

**Location:** Noida, Sector 16  
**Experience:** 4–8 Years  
**Employment:** Full\-time

About the Role

We are looking for an **EdTech Content \& Product Manager** who understands how a digital learning product is built **from scratch to final delivery**.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of **academic content, curriculum, digital course development and project management**, with the ability to bring together multiple teams to create high\-quality learning products.

If you understand **content, curriculum, course development, technology, teams, timelines and final product delivery**, we'd like to hear from you.

title: E-Commerce Manager
description:
E\-COMMERCE MANAGER

**Company:** Into India Sourcing Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Noida, Uttar Pradesh  
**Department:** E\-Commerce  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 5–8 Years  
**Reporting To:** Director  
**Working closely with:** Operations Head, Merchandising, Sourcing, Finance \& Marketing Teams

About the Role

Into India Sourcing Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced and commercially driven **E\-Commerce Manager** to lead and develop the company’s e\-commerce business and online sales operations.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing e\-commerce platforms, driving online business growth, improving product visibility and conversion, monitoring sales performance, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure smooth execution from **product sourcing to online order fulfilment**.

The role requires a combination of **e\-commerce expertise, commercial understanding, data analysis, marketplace management and strong coordination skills**.

Key Responsibilities1\. E\-Commerce Business Management

* Manage and grow the company's e\-commerce business across relevant marketplaces and online channels.
* Develop and execute strategies to increase online sales, revenue and profitability.
* Identify new e\-commerce opportunities, marketplaces and digital sales channels.
* Work closely with the Director and Operations Head on business plans, targets and growth initiatives.
* Monitor market trends, customer behaviour, competitor activity and pricing.

2\. Marketplace \& Website Management

* Manage product listings, catalogue creation, product descriptions, pricing, images and inventory across e\-commerce platforms.
* Ensure products are accurately presented and commercially positioned.
* Monitor product rankings, search visibility, conversion rates and customer reviews.
* Coordinate website/e\-commerce platform updates and improvements.
* Ensure online stores remain updated, accurate and operational.

3\. Sales \& Performance Management

* Track daily, weekly and monthly online sales performance.
* Prepare MIS and management reports covering:
* Sales
* Revenue
* Orders
* Average Order Value
* Conversion Rate
* Product performance
* Returns/cancellations
* Marketplace profitability
* Analyse sales data and identify areas for improvement.
* Set and monitor monthly/quarterly sales targets.

4\. Product \& Sourcing Coordination

* Coordinate closely with the **Sourcing and Merchandising teams** to identify products suitable for online sales.
* Analyse product demand, pricing and market trends before product launch.
* Provide market feedback to sourcing and merchandising teams.
* Support product selection based on commercial potential and customer demand.
* Coordinate new product launches and online collections.

5\. Digital Marketing \& Promotions

* Coordinate with internal/external marketing teams for online campaigns and promotions.
* Plan marketplace promotions, discounts, offers and seasonal campaigns.
* Monitor campaign performance and ROI.
* Coordinate SEO, paid advertising, social media and other digital initiatives where required.
* Improve product visibility and customer acquisition.

6\. Order \& Operations Coordination

* Work closely with Operations and Warehouse teams to ensure timely order processing and fulfilment.
* Monitor inventory availability and avoid stock\-outs/overstock situations.
* Coordinate on dispatch, returns, replacements and customer issues.
* Work with Finance on marketplace settlements, deductions, commissions and reconciliations.

7\. Business Development

* Research and evaluate new marketplaces and e\-commerce opportunities in India and international markets.
* Develop relationships with marketplace partners, agencies, technology providers and other e\-commerce vendors.
* Explore opportunities for expanding the company's online product portfolio and customer base.
* Support management in developing new digital business models.

8\. Team \& Vendor Management

* Manage and guide e\-commerce executives/agencies/vendors, where applicable.
* Coordinate with marketplace account managers and external service providers.
* Ensure timely execution of e\-commerce activities and deliverables.
* Establish processes and SOPs for efficient e\-commerce operations.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Monthly/annual online revenue growth
* Gross margin and marketplace profitability
* Order volume and conversion rate
* Product listing accuracy and catalogue quality
* Product visibility and ranking
* Customer ratings and reviews
* Return and cancellation rate
* Inventory availability
* Marketing campaign ROI
* New marketplace/channel development
* Timely order fulfilment
* Overall contribution of e\-commerce to business growth

Candidate Profile

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, E\-Commerce, Management or related field.
* MBA/PGDM in Marketing, E\-Commerce or Business Management will be an advantage.

**Experience:**

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in e\-commerce, marketplace management, online retail or digital business.
* Experience managing platforms such as Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Shopify or other relevant marketplaces.
* Experience in fashion, apparel, lifestyle, sourcing, retail or consumer products will be preferred.

Required Skills

* Strong understanding of e\-commerce business models
* Marketplace management
* Product catalogue/listing management
* Sales and commercial analysis
* Excel/Google Sheets and MIS reporting
* Inventory and order management
* Digital marketing fundamentals
* SEO/SEM understanding
* Marketplace advertising and promotions
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Vendor and stakeholder management
* Excellent communication and coordination skills

Preferred Exposure

Candidates with experience in **fashion, apparel, garment sourcing, merchandising, retail or international e\-commerce** will be preferred.

Experience with **Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, marketplace dashboards, Google Analytics, Meta Ads, Google Ads and e\-commerce reporting tools** will be an added advantage.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate should be **commercially strong, analytical and hands\-on**, with the ability to independently manage the e\-commerce function while working closely with the **Director, Operations Head, Sourcing and Merchandising teams**.

The person should be capable of converting market data and customer insights into actionable business decisions and should have a strong focus on **sales growth, profitability and scalable e\-commerce operations**.

Pay: From ₹702,088\.52 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India
Engineering \& Development
Pay range:
  
We’re looking for an experienced Technical Product Manager to own our Jobs platform and take its capabilities to the next level. Your responsibilities would span the entire pipeline from ingestion, cleansing, and indexing of jobs as they come in; through searching and matching for both users in real\-time and offline notifications; to providing front\-end product interfaces to our web property product managers. All of this needs to happen at scale across our ecosystem of many millions of jobs and job seekers.



This is an interdisciplinary role emphasizing breadth and orchestration across architecture, data engineering and science, development, analytics, and product management. A technical background is desirable and we expect a firm grasp of technical capabilities and concepts. You’ll at the very least be able to ‘read API’. However, more important is the ability to work with multiple teams to come up with a mix that works \- and works well \- for the end user. Key skills here are a strong analytical bent of mind for defining key metrics/benchmarks and measuring at scale, as well as the ability to hone in on the individual job seeker and answer the right questions: is her need being met? If not, how can we improve?



**Job Description**
-------------------


**ABOUT THIS TEAM**



BOLD Platform services team design, creates, manage and maintains the highly scalable and distributed services for the wider use of web and mobile product applications/portals/websites. The current list of services is based on Microservices architecture whose domain ranges from visitor tracking, User profiles, authentication, content and payments.



Platform team uses state of the art modern technologies like .Net framework, Python, Java, SQL Server, My SQL, Graph DB, SOLR, and a lot of other tools \& technologies serving millions of users with hundreds of million transactions everyday through a scalable and fault tolerant architecture.


**WHAT YOU’LL DO**


* Work closely with North America product leadership to understand jobs product needs and use cases.
* Work closely with senior engineering management and architecture to plot the technical vision and roadmap for the platform.
* Design, implement, and support, in cooperation with other data teams and data scientists a platform to measure our jobs quality, coverage, and relevancy through manual and automatic mechanisms.
* Analyse and measure the quality and coverage of vendor feeds.
* Measure and improve our job recommendations and search capabilities.
* Work with internal teams to build dashboards which will be used by internal stakeholders (product, office of the CEO, analytics etc).
* Measure and improve jobs data quality to point out issues with jobs data/gaps with jobs data.
* Work with the data science team to build jobs evaluation ML models.
* Evaluate jobs data coverage for jobs within the BOLD system.
* Translate business requirements and develop an end to end solution.
* Design web\-scale products following best coding principles, optimized coding practices and using open source tools \& platforms.
* Proactively identify potential problems and opportunities to improve the data pipelines related to jobs data.


**WHAT YOU’LL NEED**


* Experience in the jobs domain with a good understanding of jobs, job matching, jobs recommendations.
* Proven track record of taking ownership, thinking strategically, and successfully delivering results in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* Possess an understanding of technology stacks and level of efforts involved in order to be able to make right decisions.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with demonstrated experience engaging and influencing senior executives.
* Strong attention to detail and proven ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to use data and metrics to back up assumptions, recommendations and drive actions.
* Engineering/ Master’s Degree from a good Institute (preferably Computer Science or related).


 **EXPERIENCE\-**


* Technical Product Manager\- 10 years\+

  



**Benefits**
------------


**Outstanding Compensation**


* Competitive salary
* Tax\-friendly compensation structure
* Bi\-annual bonus
* Annual Appraisal
* Equity in company


**100% Full Health Benefits**


* Group Mediclaim, personal accident, \& term life insurance
* Group Mediclaim benefit (including parents' coverage)
* Online Health (OPD) Consultation Benefit
* Personal accident and term life insurance coverage


**Flexible Time Away**


* 24 days paid leaves
* Declared fixed holidays
* Paternity and maternity leave
* Compassionate and marriage leave
* Covid leave (up to 7 days)


**Additional Benefits**


* Internet and home office reimbursement
* In\-office catered lunch, meals, and snacks
* Certification policy
* Cab pick\-up and drop\-off facility
**About BOLD**
--------------


**We Transform Work Lives**



As an established global organization, BOLD helps people find jobs. Our story is one of growth, success, and professional fulfillment. We create digital products that have empowered millions of people in 180 countries to build stronger resumes, cover letters, and CVs. The result of our work helps people interview confidently, finding the right job in less time. Our employees are experts, learners, contributors, and creatives.


**We Celebrate And Promote Diversity And Inclusion**



We value our position as an Equal Opportunity Employer. We hire based on qualifications, merit, and our business needs. title: Media Planning Manager
company: Dr. Bakshi's Bakson's Homoeopathy South Extension
description:
**Job Description: Media Planning Manager**

**Role Summary:\-**

Bakson Group is looking for a strategic and results\-driven Media Planning Manager to lead the social media team and manage integrated advertising and branding initiatives for Sunny and Bakson Medicines.

The role will be responsible for audience research, campaign strategy, media planning, budget allocation, brand development, and performance optimisation across digital and offline channels. The candidate will work closely with creative, product, sales, medical, and external agency teams to deliver consistent and effective brand communication.

**Key Responsibilities:\-**

**1\. Social Media Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and manage the social media team.
* Develop platform\-specific social media strategies and content calendars.
* Oversee content creation, design, copywriting, publishing, and community engagement.
* Ensure consistent brand messaging across all social media platforms.
* Monitor social media performance and guide the team in improving reach, engagement, leads, and conversions.
* Establish workflows, timelines, and performance goals for the team.

**2\. Advertising Campaign Planning**

* Design integrated advertising campaigns aligned with the company’s business and brand objectives.
* Develop campaign briefs covering objectives, target audiences, messaging, channels, budgets, and timelines.
* Plan campaigns across social media, search, display, video, influencer marketing, print, outdoor, retail, and events.
* Coordinate campaign development from initial concept through execution and performance review.
* Test different audiences, creatives, messages, and media formats to improve campaign effectiveness.

**3\. Media Planning and Budget Allocation**

* Prepare annual, quarterly, and campaign\-level media plans.
* Allocate advertising budgets across appropriate digital channels based on campaign objectives and expected returns.
* Recommend the right mix of paid, owned, and earned media.
* Monitor media spending and optimise budgets according to campaign performance.
* Track metrics including reach, impressions, engagement, leads, conversions, cost per lead, and return on advertising spend.
* Prepare regular budget utilisation and campaign performance reports for management.

**4\. Online and Offline Branding**

* Develop and implement branding strategies for Sunny and Bakson Medicines.
* Maintain consistency in brand positioning, identity, tone of voice, and visual communication.
* Plan digital branding across social media, websites, e\-commerce platforms, search engines, and online advertising.
* Manage offline branding across print, outdoor media, retail locations, exhibitions, events, dealer networks, and point\-of\-sale materials.
* Support product launches, promotional campaigns, seasonal initiatives, and brand activations.
* Review and approve campaign creatives, advertisements, brochures, catalogues, standees, product literature, and other marketing materials.
* Ensure that pharmaceutical and healthcare communication follows applicable advertising and regulatory guidelines.

**5\. Audience and Market Research**

* Conduct research to understand audience demographics, behaviours, interests, needs, and media consumption patterns.
* Build audience segments and customer personas for different products and campaigns.
* Analyse market trends, competitor activities, customer feedback, and category developments.
* Identify new audience groups, media platforms, and brand\-growth opportunities.
* Use research findings and campaign data to improve targeting, messaging, and media selection.

**6\. Strategy Development**

* Develop short\-term and long\-term media strategies aligned with Bakson Group’s marketing and business goals.
* Translate business objectives into actionable media and communication plans.
* Define campaign objectives, audience segments, channel strategies, budgets, timelines, and success metrics.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen the market position of Sunny and Bakson Medicines.
* Present strategic recommendations, media plans, and campaign results to senior management.
* Continuously refine strategies based on performance data, customer insights, and market developments.

**7\. Cross\-Team Collaboration**

* Collaborate with marketing, creative, sales, product, medical, e\-commerce, and management teams.
* Work with internal stakeholders to understand product priorities and commercial objectives.
* Coordinate with designers, content writers, digital marketers, agencies, influencers, publishers, and media vendors.
* Ensure campaign requirements, responsibilities, timelines, and deliverables are clearly communicated.
* Support sales and distribution teams with relevant brand and promotional materials.
* Manage agency and vendor relationships to ensure timely, high\-quality, and cost\-effective execution.

**Key Performance Indicators:\-**

* Growth in brand awareness, reach, engagement, and share of voice.
* Achievement of campaign lead, conversion, and revenue objectives.
* Return on advertising spend and efficient media budget utilisation.
* Improvement in cost per reach, cost per lead, and customer acquisition cost.
* Timely delivery of campaigns and content calendars.
* Consistency of Sunny and Bakson Medicines branding across channels.
* Performance and development of the social media team.
* Successful delivery of product launches and brand activations.
* Quality and accuracy of campaign reports and strategic recommendations.

**Qualifications and Experience:\-**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Advertising, Mass Communication, Media Management, or a related field.
* Approximately 5–8 years of experience in media planning, digital marketing, advertising, or brand management.
* Previous experience managing a social media or digital marketing team.
* Strong experience in advertising campaign planning and digital budget allocation.
* Experience in pharmaceuticals, healthcare, wellness, FMCG, or consumer products is preferred.
* Working knowledge of Meta Ads, Google Ads, YouTube, display advertising, and social media analytics.
* Experience working with agencies, media vendors, influencers, and cross\-functional teams.
* Familiarity with offline media, retail branding, events, exhibitions, and brand activations.

* Strategic and analytical thinking
* Team leadership and mentoring
* Media planning and budget management
* Audience segmentation and consumer insights
* Digital and offline brand management
* Campaign analysis and optimisation
* Creative judgment and attention to detail
* Stakeholder and agency management
* Strong written and verbal communication
* Project and time management

title: Senior Associate, Relationship Manager, Credit Program Medium, Small Medium Enterprises

Through our continued commitment, DBS has cultivated long\-standing relationships with its customers in the region that are based on account relationship management, service differentiation, product development and rigorous credit standards.

* To acquire and build a well\-diversified portfolio within the IBG 4 segment. The portfolio should provide revenue from diversified sources such as assets, trade, cash, treasury, fees etc. and the portfolio should lead to healthy income with an acceptable risk to the bank.
* Relationship Manager is expected to deliver these results in accordance with the lending guidelines prescribed by the bank.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Source New to Bank Asset relationships within IBG 4 Segment ie. Companies ranging from a Turnover of INR 25 crores to 600 crores, aligned to Bank Lending Policy
* Ensure a good Net Interest Income as well as fee across the portfolio and also ensure regular revenue streams through Cross Sell of Trade, Liabilities, Cash, Treasury, Fee, etc.
* Play an instrumental role in increasing the Profitability of the business
